# Benchmarks

Measured over `test/fixtures/` on 2026-09-14, with:

```
resvg      0.48.1
pngquant   3.0.3
oxipng     oxipng 10.2.1
node       v26.8.2
```

These numbers come from the fixtures in this repository, which are not the 39-mark
corpus the original decisions were taken on. Where they disagree, these are the ones
to trust: they are the ones you can reproduce.

## Accuracy: pct by mark, size and palette size

pct = share of pixels more than 8/255 from an unquantised reference, worse of a white and a black composite. The bar is 1.0 %. `gradient` is excluded from the worst-case line: it exists to make the lossless path win, and asking 8 colours of a four-stop gradient is meant to be bad.

## Which candidate wins, at --colors 8

One row per (mark, size) over 10 marks x 5 sizes. "keep smallest" is the guard from decision 7: it costs nothing when it never fires and stops a raised --colors from producing larger files.

```
files                 50
no dither wins        42
Floyd-Steinberg wins  8
no pngquant wins      0

always no-dither      39334 B
keep smallest         39271 B  (-0.16 %)
```

## Stage order at 192 px

pngquant re-encodes from scratch, so anything oxipng did before it is discarded. The measurement is not close.

```
pngquant then oxipng  7378 B
oxipng then pngquant  7963 B  (7.9 %)
```

## Zopfli iterations

The default is 15. Bytes ship forever and build time does not, so the knee is taken on the byte side - but the curve is flat past 120.

```
  --zi     bytes    vs 15   seconds
    15     27868    0.00%      25.4
    30     27804   -0.23%      42.6
    60     27738   -0.47%      79.4
   120     27690   -0.64%     138.0
   240     27678   -0.68%     273.6
```

## Serial against concurrent rasters (decision 13, re-measured)

Four jobs - 180 px on a ground, 192, 512 and the 32 px ICO payload - through the full pipeline. 3 interleaved repetitions per arm, identical work in every arm, on a 16-core machine. The --zi axis is here because favicon.sh passes a bare --zopfli (which is --zi 15) where favcon passes --zi 120, and a comparison that varied only the scheduling would have credited that to concurrency.

```
 at once  --zi     wall     min     max  child cpu   cores    bytes  vs shipped
1 (serial)   120   33.45s   30.85   37.55     278.5s    8.3x     8548        0.0%
       4   120   34.52s   32.21   37.06     516.2s   15.0x     8548        3.2%
1 (serial)    15    8.50s    8.33    8.70      64.4s    7.6x     8631      -74.6%
       4    15    8.14s    7.80    8.54     118.4s   14.5x     8631      -75.7%
```

**concurrency buys -3.2 % at --zi 120; dropping to --zi 15 buys 74.6 % and costs 83 B**

## The ICO container

A PNG payload against icotool's default BMP one, and favcon's 22-byte writer against `icotool -c -r`.

```
raw PNG payload       2403 B
BMP payload           39340 B  (16.4x)
byte-identical to icotool -c -r   10/10
```
